name: IKAROS family zinc finger 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IKZF3 encodes zinc finger protein Aiolos. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and mesoderm development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency 84 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
